name: dspy-appliance-support-bot
description: Vertical appliance: a pre-wired DSPy.ts support assistant. Ships a ready-to-run program — RetrieveModule (MMR) over an AgentDB knowledge base → ChainOfThought answer with citations → a quality metric (helpfulness + groundedness + honest 'I don't know') → MIPROv2 tuning. Bring your own KB; commands scaffold it into your repo, answer questions, and tune the answerer.
